title: Medical Model Configuration Schema
description: This schema defines the structure for configuring medical model pipelines, including data preprocessing, feature generation, and prediction. It is used for validation and to provide autocompletion in compatible editors.

model_json_version.description: Version of the model JSON schema.

serialize_learning_set.description: If '1' or 'true', the training samples (learning set) will be serialized and stored within the model file. This is useful for debugging and reproducibility, but increases file size.

generate_masks_for_features.description: If '1' or 'true', a binary mask will be generated for features with missing values before any imputation is performed. This allows the model to potentially learn from the pattern of missingness.

max_data_in_mem.description: Maximum size of data (in terms of array elements, i.e., features * rows) to hold in memory at once. If the dataset exceeds this limit, it will be processed in batches. A value of 0 means no limit.

take_mean_pred.description: For models that produce multiple predictions (e.g., ensembles), this setting determines if the mean of the predictions should be taken. '1' for true, '0' for false.

model_actions.description: An array of components that define the model's pipeline. Actions are executed in the order they appear.

predictor.description: The machine learning algorithm to be used for prediction.

predictor_params.description: A string of key-value pairs (e.g., 'param1=value1,param2=value2') that will be passed to the predictor for configuration.

oneOf.title: Feature Generator: Age/Gender
oneOf.description: Generates features for age or gender.

oneOf.title: Feature Generator: Basic
oneOf.description: The most common feature generator, creating features from a single signal based on various aggregation types.

oneOf.title: Feature Generator: Unified Smoking
oneOf.description: Generates features related to smoking status.

smoking_features.description: Comma-separated list of smoking features to generate.

oneOf.title: Feature Generator: Time
oneOf.description: Generates features based on time, such as day of the week or month.

oneOf.title: Feature Generator: Singleton
oneOf.description: Generates a binary feature indicating if a categorical signal's value is in a given set.

sets.description: Set of categories to check for.

oneOf.title: Feature Generator: BinnedLM
oneOf.description: Generates features using a binned linear model.

oneOf.title: Feature Generator: Range
oneOf.description: Generates features from signals that represent time ranges.

oneOf.title: Feature Generator: Category Dependent
oneOf.description: Generates features based on statistical dependency between categorical signals.

action.title: Model Component Action
action.description: A single step in the model processing pipeline.

oneOf.title: Repository Processor Action Set
oneOf.description: A set of repository processors to be applied to the data. These processors perform data cleaning, transformation, and virtual signal creation.

oneOf.title: Feature Processor Action Set
oneOf.description: A set of processors that are applied to the generated features.

oneOf.title: Post Processor Action Set
oneOf.description: A set of processors applied after the model prediction.

name.description: Name of the feature to clean.

normalizeSd.description: If true, normalize by standard deviation.

fillMissing.description: If true, fill missing values with the mean.

percentage.description: The percentage of a single value that defines a feature as degenerate.

time_channel.description: Time channel to use for cleaning.

val_channel.description: Value channel to use for cleaning.

nrem_attr.description: Attribute name to store the number of removed values.

ntrim_attr.description: Attribute name to store the number of trimmed values.

nrem_suff.description: Suffix for the attribute name for removed values.

ntrim_suff.description: Suffix for the attribute name for trimmed values.

unconditional.description: If true, the processor is always applied.

print_summary.description: If true, a summary of the cleaning is printed.

print_summary_critical_cleaned.description: Cleaning ratio threshold to trigger a critical warning.

conf_file.description: Path to the configuration file for outlier parameters.

rules2Signals.description: Path to file defining which signals participate in which rule.

signal_channels.description: Path to file defining time and value channels for signals.

time_window.description: Time window in which to look for signals to apply a rule.

consideredRules.description: Comma-separated list of rule IDs to consider.

calculator.description: The type of calculation to perform.

V_names.description: Names for the output virtual signals.

panels.description: Comma-separated list of panels to complete (e.g., 'red_line,lipids').

metadata_file.description: Path to metadata file with signal resolutions and conversion factors.

rp_complete.title: RP: Panel Completer
rp_complete.description: Completes (fills-in) missing values in common medical panels where signals are physiologically related.

time_channels.description: Comma-separated list of time channels for each signal.

attrName.description: Attribute name to store the compliance check result.

rp_signal_rate.title: RP: Signal Rate
rp_signal_rate.description: Calculates a rate by dividing a signal's value by time.

signals.description: Comma-separated list of signals to combine.

factors.description: Comma-separated list of factors for each signal.

rp_combine.title: RP: Combine Signals
rp_combine.description: Combines multiple signals into a single virtual signal.

output_names.description: Comma-separated names for the output signals.

sets.description: Semicolon-separated lists of categories to define the split.

rp_split.title: RP: Split Signal
rp_split.description: Splits a signal into multiple virtual signals based on categorical values.

rp_aggregate.title: RP: Aggregate Signal
rp_aggregate.description: Aggregates a signal's values over a sliding time window.

rp_history_limit.title: RP: History Limit
rp_history_limit.description: Limits the history of a signal to a specified time window relative to the prediction point.

rp_create_registry.title: RP: Create Registry
rp_create_registry.description: Creates a registry signal (e.g., for diagnoses or conditions).

rp_bit_signal.title: RP: Create Bit Signal
rp_bit_signal.description: Creates a virtual signal where each bit represents the state of a category (e.g., a medication).

rp_category_descenders.title: RP: Category Descenders
rp_category_descenders.description: Creates all descender values for each category value.

new_order.description: An array specifying the new order of channels.

rp_numeric_noiser.title: RP: Numeric Noiser
rp_numeric_noiser.description: Adds Gaussian noise to values and uniform noise to time for a numeric signal.

rp_filter_by_diag.title: RP: Filter by Diagnosis
rp_filter_by_diag.description: Clears a signal based on diagnosis codes.
